|game_text=Deploy on table. Bounty Hunters and your unique (•) Independent starships are defense value +1 and forfeit +2. |errata_history=Versions of [[Desilijic Tattoo (V)]] in [[Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time]], in date order (2 versions). Slip texts are quoted as printed: ▼ and ▲ are the slips' arrow icons (deploy from / take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle), and the immunity and pilot icons are the ones explained in each sheet's icon key (see [[Virtual card icons]]). Found while adding the original pre-Remaster slips (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): first release sheet “Virtual Set #5” (Players Committee, 30 May 2003; tournament legal 6 June 2003), page 3, slip 35 — [https://web.archive.org/web/20030801181811/http://www.theforce.net/ccg/vcards/SWCCGVirtualSet5.pdf PDF on theforce.net] linked from the [https://web.archive.org/web/20030603182926/http://swccgpc.com:80/interior.htm PC news post of 30 May 2003] (Internet Archive capture of the PDF, 1 August 2003; PDF dated 30–31 May 2003): “Deploy on table. Bounty Hunters and your unique (•) Independent starships are defense value +1 and forfeit +2. Once per turn, when a bounty hunter hits a character with a non-permanent weapon, target is forfeit -2 and opponent loses top card of Reserve Deck (may not be reduced). A” The slip is the old pre-template slip the Committee used before its December 2006 Remaster: the Decipher-style lower half with the slip mark “5•35” at bottom right and no expansion icon. The revised sheet of 11 June 2003 (PDF dated 11 June 2003; the copy the Players Committee still hosts at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards5.pdf res.starwarsccg.org]) prints the same words on the same old slip ([[:File:OVS5-35-Desilijic_Tattoo-original-slip-2003-06-11.png]]).
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Desilijic Tattoo (V) (Virtual Set 5) (Errata)]]): the Remaster sheet (official text as of 4 December 2006; [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024154714/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards5.pdf Internet Archive capture of 24 October 2007], slip 35), in the Committee's Remaster template: “Deploy on table. Bounty Hunters and your [Independent] starships are defense value +1 and forfeit +2. Once per turn, when a bounty hunter uses a non-[[Permanent Weapon]] weapon to hit a character, target is forfeit -2 and opponent places top card of Reserve Deck in Lost Pile. (Immune to Alter.)” '''What changed:''' the Remaster rewrote the slip in the Committee's later wording (full text above; icons written out in words here). This is the current text of the Virtual Original card.
